caseNameFull: SPENCER, ADMINISTRATRIX, Et Al. v. HIBERNIA BANK Et Al.
attorneys: M. Mitchell Bourquin and George Olshausen for appellants., Moses Lasky and James Farraher for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
